subject: Evidence request: tokenized logs and TTL snapshot during Monday throughput spike
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@cobaltbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: CobaltBank Ops <ops@cobaltbank.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Payments latency spike & failed requests — need audit evidence

Neha,

We observed a substantial latency and 502/504 error spike impacting payment authorization requests between 07:50-08:10 PDT on Monday (2027-08-11). Our CTO is requesting an incident packet for executive review that includes exact request counts, error rates, and preserved logs for that window.

Specifically we need:
- All server-side request/response logs for the 07:45-08:30 PDT window (raw if available)
- Any runtime traces or host-level metrics that show GPU/CPU starvation or network errors
- A chain-of-custody statement showing who accessed preserved artifacts and when

We need to hand this to our legal and compliance folks by EOD tomorrow. Please confirm what you can produce and how you will preserve the material (S3 path + retention).

Thanks,
Alice Monroe
Head of Infrastructure, CobaltBank
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@cobaltbank.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 08:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: URGENT: Payments latency spike & failed requests — need audit evidence

Alice — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the impact. We are treating this as an exec-level escalation and will preserve everything you listed. Immediate plan (action items below).

Action items (we've kicked these off):
1) Preserve logs & metrics (Evelyn + Marcus) — snapshot all runtime logs, API gateway traces, and host metrics for 07:30-08:45 PDT.
2) Security/legal hold (David) — apply legal hold and provide chain-of-custody template.
3) Customer communications (Hannah) — keep CobaltBank updated on progress and expected delivery times.

Please confirm the exact timeframe you want preserved; defaulting to 07:30-08:45 PDT unless you instruct otherwise. Attached a short preservation checklist we use (preservation_instructions.pdf).

Neha
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: preservation_instructions.pdf (PDF)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: URGENT: Preservation started — runtime snapshots & S3 path

Neha/Evelyn —

We took the following preservation steps at 09:05 PDT:
- Exported API gateway access logs and error traces for 2027-08-11T07:30:00-2027-08-11T08:45:00 PDT.
- Captured runtime traces (per-request traces) from the serving runtime; masked user tokens and any inline PII per our standard redaction filter.
- Dumped KV cache index at TTL snapshot; produced a hash-indexed archive for chain-of-custody.
- Collected host metrics (nvidia-smi, top snapshots) and scheduler logs.

All artifacts are in the preservation bucket: s3://redwood-preserve/cobaltbank/2027-08-11/
Index manifest: s3://redwood-preserve/cobaltbank/2027-08-11/manifest-20270811.txt

Notes on masking: traces include token placeholders (<<REDACTED_TOKEN>>) and request body hashes for later correlation. If Legal asks for raw bodies we will place them in a separate encrypted bucket and provide hashed indexes only to non-privileged reviewers.

Attaching a csv summary of runtime metrics for the window: runtime_metrics_20270811.csv

Marcus
SRE Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: runtime_metrics_20270811.csv (CSV)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 10:05:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Legal hold & chain-of-custody for CobaltBank incident

Team —

Please follow these legal-preservation constraints before sharing any artifacts externally:
1) Do NOT share raw request bodies containing customer-provided data or tokens without express written consent.
2) Place raw request bodies in the encrypted legal-hold bucket: s3://redwood-legalhold/cobaltbank/2027-08-11/ and set ACL so only Security+Legal have access. Provide a salted SHA256 index for cross-referencing.
3) Produce a simple chain-of-custody log (who accessed which object, when, and for what purpose). See attached signed_legal_hold.docx for the template and sign-off required for external delivery.

I will notify Compliance and generate the formal audit evidence pack once the bucket indexes are available. If CobaltBank requests raw payloads we need a redaction plan and a documented DD request form signed by their legal team.

David Kim
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: signed_legal_hold.docx (DOCX)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: URGENT: Evidence request: tokenized logs and TTL snapshot during Monday throughput spike

Priya — forwarding the thread for visibility. Exec asks for a short incident packet for the CobaltBank CTO and their exec table. Summary below: 

Executive note (for packet):
- Incident window: 2027-08-11 07:30-08:45 PDT.
- Impact: transient 8–12s tail latency spikes on payment flow; ~3% 502/504 rate at peak.
- Preservation: runtime traces, access logs, KV cache snapshot preserved to s3://redwood-preserve/cobaltbank/2027-08-11/ (manifest included).
- Next steps: Security to produce audit pack and chain-of-custody; Product + SRE to coordinate a follow-up RCA and remediation timeline.

Hannah — please prepare a 1-page packet for the CTO and add the legal hold summary.

Neha

> > Neha,
> > We observed a substantial latency...

To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: James Wu <james.wu@cobaltbank.com>, CobaltBank Ops <ops@cobaltbank.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: tokenized logs and TTL snapshot during Monday throughput spike

Neha — thanks for the quick preservation and the S3 path. Our security/compliance team reviewed the manifest and will require: 
- The chain-of-custody log (per David's template)
- The JIRA ticket for the incident (we referenced RINF-8342)
- A DocuSign/attestation from Redwood Legal confirming that raw payloads will only be accessed under a signed DD and that redaction controls are in place

We expect to receive a formal audit pack by EOD Monday (2027-08-16). Please confirm delivery ETA and whether Redwood Legal can sign the attestation.

Alice Monroe
Head of Infrastructure, CobaltBank
